title: Move zeroes
summary: Return `nums` with every 0 moved to the end and the other elements in their original order.
hints: Describe the result in two parts: what comes first, and what fills the rest?
The non-zero values appear first, in their original order, and the remaining slots are zeros. Keep a position that marks where the next non-zero value should go.
Walk the array with a write position starting at 0. Copy each non-zero value to the write position and advance it. Then fill from the write position to the end with zeros.
takeaway: A slow write position and a fast read position rearrange an array in one pass, O(n). The same shape solves "remove duplicates" and "remove a value" problems.
